label: Start Workflow
description: Starts the workflow that the newly created item refers to. That workflow is found by following the chain of references named in Workflow from.

workflowFrom.label: Workflow from
workflowFrom.description: The chain of references, starting from the new item, leading to the workflow version to start, e.g. "schemaVersion/workflow".

replaceActive.label: Replace active
replaceActive.description: Whether to first cancel any instance of the same workflow still active on the host, whatever its version.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the handler works on: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
